text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
ROMANIA LIBERA
- A fast restructuring of Romania's industry could boost the country's chances of getting blocked World Bank loans, Bank resident representative Francois Ettori says in an interview.
ADEVARUL
- The supplies of Russian gas to Romania are expected to double to 12.9 billion cubic metres by the year 2010.
- The price of domestic cigarettes went up by 50 percent.
- An artificially held leu currency discourages export activities, a Romanian company manager says in an interview.
TINERETUL LIBER
- Bucharest's Intercontinental Hotel will remain affiliated to the Intercontinental Hotels chain for the next 10 years.
- Year-on-year inflation will not exceed 40 percent in 1996, central bank sources are quoted as saying.
AZI
- The state budget deficit, the trade gap and inflation will be the sensitive issues which Romania will discuss with IMF experts expected here in the next few days.
General:
ROMANIA LIBERA
- The newspaper reports on President Emil Constantinescu's meetings with various heads of state and prime ministers during the two-day OSCE summit in Lisbon.
ADEVARUL
- The newspaper publishes basic elements of the governing programme of Prime Minister-designate Victor Ciorbea.
- The Hungarian parliament will ratify the friendship treaty with Romania next week, Hungarian Prime Minister Gyula Horn said after meeting Constantinescu in Lisbon.
- Outgoing Prime Minister Nicolae Vacaroiu, elected Senator for the Party of Social Democracy (PDSR), will be appointed vice-president of the Banca Comerciala Romana.
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI
- "The time has come for the new rulers in Romania to allow the people access to their former Securitate secret police files," said Nicolae Ulieriu, spokesman of the Romanian Intelligence Service.
AZI

- The outgoing ministers will lead commissions in the upper house, the Senate -- Foreign Minister Teodor Melescanu leads the foreign policy commission, ex-prime Minister Vacaroiu the privatisation commission and former Labour Minister Dan Mircea Popescu the social affairs commission.
COTIDIANUL

- Ciorbea said the governing programme and the members of his cabinet will be presented in parliament on Tuesday. The specialised commissions, still to be created in both parliament houses, will first hear all the proposed cabinet members.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- Former President Ion Iliescu was elected honorary president of the national confederation of the December 1989 revolutionaries. ($=3,610 lei) -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
